assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Dorbit alien spacecraft modeling reference sheet, landscape high-resolution.
Primary request: Create a production-quality reference sheet for ONE original hostile spacecraft for a full-3D space game. Mechanical alien spacecraft, not a creature. Cohesive art direction with fitted contoured armor, gunmetal chassis, exposed hydraulic joints, machined titanium trim, recessed engines, armored sensor slits and restrained colored emissive elements. Hard-surface PBR-style rendered concept art suitable for building an editable Blender mesh.
Scene/backdrop: clean light neutral gray studio background, thin understated grid dividers. No environment.
Composition: one large fully visible front three-quarter hero perspective in the upper left, five smaller clearly separated construction views labeled TOP, SIDE, FRONT, REAR, UNDERSIDE. Arrange all six views above a bottom strip of three close-ups labeled ARMOR, JOINT, DRIVE. Hero view takes roughly one third of the sheet and makes the unique silhouette readable. Generous margins; no cropped hulls or overlapping views. All views depict the SAME craft with consistent armor, weapons, drive count and appendages. Top and underside point nose upward; side points nose left; front and rear are square-on. Bottom close-ups show actual corresponding features of that craft.
Lighting: balanced studio lighting, readable shadowed machinery and seam depth; subtle emission, no bloom haze.
Materials: colored coated armor, dark graphite recesses, brushed exposed metal on chamfers, sparse service scratches and edge wear. Large deliberate interlocking panels and meaningful structural detail rather than repetitive micro-greebles.
Constraints: bilateral symmetry; solid buildable connected geometry; weapons forward and propulsion aft; no cockpit glass, humans, logos, watermark, stats, dimensions, scale bars or invented lore. Avoid copying an existing commercial spacecraft. Each orthogonal view must match the hero silhouette. Title only as specified below.

Subject: Skirmisher, M2 / Outer Patrol. The lighter, fastest M2 hunter. A slim elongated needle-shaped central hull with a pair of narrow backward-swept scythe wings; clear open negative space between the wings and the fuselage. Two small integrated aft drives and two compact forward energy cannons mounted at the wing roots. Low dorsal keel, shallow belly, lean skeletal hydraulic wing connections. The design must feel agile and purpose-built, with mint-green coated armor (#74e6b2) as a clearly visible dominant accent on gunmetal structure and mint sensor/drive emission. DISTINCT SILHOUETTE: narrow needle and swept scythes, not a broad wedge.
Text (verbatim): "SKIRMISHER" as the large sheet title and "M2 / Outer Patrol" as the small subtitle; the view labels specified above. Use restrained legible technical typography.

Subject: Raider, M2 / Outer Patrol. The tougher but relatively low-profile M2 ambush craft. Broad flattened split-pincer silhouette: short armored central fuselage, two forward-reaching thick hooked mandibles separated by a deep U-shaped open gap, integrated gun at each inner mandible tip, and two rectangular aft engine pods blended into the outer shoulders. Low wide stance, layered jaw armor, visible structural bridge and hydraulic braces behind the split nose. Teal-coated armor (#37bdb8) as a clearly visible dominant accent on gunmetal structure and teal sensor/drive emission. DISTINCT SILHOUETTE: wide horseshoe with a split nose and two large forward hooks, no needle nose or swept crescent wings.

Subject: Marauder, M3 / Debris Fields. A mobile armored M3 attack craft with a long axehead-like central prow and four staggered angular blade outriggers: one smaller forward pair and one longer rear pair. Two forward gun housings recessed alongside the prow, and three aft engine exhausts in a triangular cluster integrated into one plated drive assembly. Medium-depth layered hull, exposed armored couplings and cooling vents. Amber-gold coated armor (#ffc36e) as a clearly visible dominant accent over gunmetal structure; amber sensor slits and drive emission. DISTINCT SILHOUETTE: four blade fins around an axehead prow, unmistakably different from the existing two-wing Scout and heavier Warden. Buildable machinery rather than spikes attached at random.
Text (verbatim): "MARAUDER" as the large sheet title and "M3 / Debris Fields" as the small subtitle; the view labels specified above. Use restrained legible technical typography.

Subject: Warden, M3 / Debris Fields. The slow heavily shielded M3 guardian craft. A wide high-profile armored shield-crab silhouette, blunt hexagonal front face, thick overlapping dorsal carapace, two compact forward gun housings beneath the armor lip, a substantial central ventral armored spine and two broad rear turbine drives. Thick short lateral armor shields attached by visible reinforced knuckles, but no long talons. Orange-coral coated armor (#ee7954) as a clearly visible dominant accent on gunmetal structure; coral sensor/drive emission. DISTINCT SILHOUETTE: broad blunt shield wall with a raised segmented carapace and deep belly, conveys durability rather than agility; not an enlarged Marauder.

Subject: Ravager, M4 / Frontier. An aggressive advanced M4 pursuit craft, elongated segmented spear-like fuselage with two long forward-swept raptor blades attached at its rear-mid shoulders. Magenta-pink coated armor (#ed70c1) as a clearly visible dominant accent on gunmetal structure, magenta sensor/drive emission.
